originalTitle: Overwatch Animated Short | “In the Wolf's Mouth”
content: It’s Doomfist vs. Vendetta in the final confrontation for control of Talon. After a year of shifting loyalties and ruthless ambition, the Reign of Talon ends here. Witness it all in our newest animated short, “In the Wolf's Mouth.” And as the Reign of Talon comes to an end, a new beginning is on horizon. Stay tuned for even more in Overwatch Season 5: A Grim Doctrine today.
